dataExport.title: Your data
dataExport.lead: You can ask for a copy of everything we hold about your account. We prepare it in the background and hand it back as a single JSON file.
dataExport.scope: It contains only what is yours. Messages someone else wrote — even inside your conversation or under your thread — are their data and are not in the file.
dataExport.queued: We are preparing your data. We will tell you here when it is ready.
dataExport.preparingBody: This can take a few minutes. You can close the page — it will keep going.
dataExport.readyBody: You can download it until {date}. After that it is deleted from the server.
dataExport.downloadFailed: We could not download the file. Please try again.
dataExport.expiredBody: The file has been deleted from the server. You can request a new one whenever you like.
dataExport.failedBody: We could not prepare your copy. Request it again; if it keeps failing, get in touch.
dataExport.failed: We could not request your data.
